blocks.highlighted: import { useId, useMemo, useState } from 'react' import { buildAdjacency, connectedIds, diagramEdges, type DiagramSpec } from '@aesthc/diagram-lib' import { layoutDiagram } from '@aesthc/diagram-lib/layouts' import { DiagramCanvas } from '@aesthc/diagram-lib/canvas' import '@aesthc/diagram-lib/styles.css' const spec = { "type": "flowchart", "caption": "Request flow", "legend": { "main": "Main path", "branch": "Alternative" }, "nodes": [ { "id": "a", "label": "Request", "description": "Receive a request." }, { "id": "b", "label": "Response", "description": "Return a response." } ], "edges": [ { "id": "request", "from": "a", "to": "b" } ], "direction": "top-down" } satisfies DiagramSpec export function Diagram() { const instanceId = useId() const [hovered, setHovered] = useState<string | null>(null) const [focused, setFocused] = useState<string | null>(null) const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null) const layout = useMemo(() => layoutDiagram(spec), []) const adjacency = useMemo(() => buildAdjacency(diagramEdges(spec)), []) const active = hovered ?? focused ?? selected const highlight = active ? connectedIds(active, adjacency) : null return <DiagramCanvas layout={layout} highlight={highlight} activeNodeId={active} focusedNodeId={focused} selectedNodeId={selected} onTooltipNodeChange={(id, open) => setHovered(open ? id : null)} onFocusNode={setFocused} onSelectNode={(id) => setSelected(selected === id ? null : id)} onDismissNode={() => { setHovered(null); setSelected(null) }} instanceId={instanceId} ariaLabel={spec.caption} nodeVisuals={{}} /> }
